A '''technician''' was stationed in the [[Moog Mot VI Imperial garrison|Imperial Garrison]] on [[Moog Mot VI]] in [[1 BBY/Legends|1 BBY]]. He was working in the laboratory where [[Sollima's chief accounting droid|Sollima's accounting droid]] was located when [[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo]] and [[Billal Batross]], disguised as Imperial Officers, infiltrated it in order to retrieve the droid. The technician asked them the clearance code, but was punched by Han Solo and was incapacitated, allowing two scoundrels to retrieve the droid. Both however, did not escape the Garrison and were soon detained by a [[Squad/Legends|squad]] of [[Stormtrooper/Legends|stormtroopers]].
